name: Super Dangan Ronpa 2x2 Kyouki Mode
original_name: スーパーダンガンロンパ２×２ キョウキモード
source:
Jabberwock Island – once a popular tourist destination, this now uninhabited island remains oddly pristine. You and your classmates at the elite Hope's Peak Academy have been brought to this island by your super-cute teacher for a “lovey-dovey, heart-throbbing school trip.” Everyone seems to be having fun in the sun...until Monokuma returns to restart his murderous game! Trapped on this island of mutual killing, your only hope of escape rests in solving the island’s mysteries. But be warned—sometimes the truth can be its own despair...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3751230/Danganronpa_2x2/]Steam[/url]]

Slayhem Mode features the same cast, setting, and premise as [url=https://vndb.org/v7679]Original Mode[/url], but presents a brand new full-length scenario that deviates from its predecessor very early on, resulting in a killing game with a fresh chain of victims, culprits, and tricks.
translation:
贾巴沃克岛——这座昔日广受欢迎的度假胜地如今虽已荒无人烟，却依然出奇地保持着整洁如初的面貌。就读于精英名校“希望峰学园”的你与同班同学们，被超级可爱的老师带到这座海岛，开启一场“甜甜蜜蜜、小鹿乱撞的修学旅行”。阳光之下，众人原本正玩得尽兴……直到黑白熊卷土重来，重启他那场残酷的自相残杀游戏！被困在这座自相残杀的孤岛上，你们逃出生天的唯一希望，便寄托在解开海岛重重谜团之上。但请当心——有时候，真相本身亦可能化作绝望……

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3751230/Danganronpa_2x2/]Steam[/url]]

“疯狂模式”沿用了与[url=https://vndb.org/v7679]原版模式[/url]相同的登场角色、舞台背景与基本设定，但呈现了全新编写的长篇完整剧情——故事在极早期便偏离了前作的走向，由此引出一场被害人、凶手与作案手法焕然一新的自相残杀游戏。
